{{Quote|How can I assist you?|translated=1|Adi'son greets a customer|audio=Adison-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Adi'son''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]] [[Merchant|vendor]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the Twi'lek was operating a stall selling stimulants and [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] in the [[Gnarls Outpost|training grounds]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region of the world while the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fought an [[Flesh Raider uprising|uprising]] of the local [[Flesh Raider]] [[Species/Legends|species]] there. Adi'son had [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], yellow-green skin, and spoke [[Language/Legends|language]] other than [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. The merchant wore a dark gray [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]] with light gray pants and [[Boot/Legends|boots]] while at their stall.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adi'son appears in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
